title: CHANNEL_CLOSE not answered with CHANNEL_CLOSE
quote: Upon receiving this message, a party MUST send back an SSH_MSG_CHANNEL_CLOSE unless it has already sent this message for the channel.
rationale: After CH_OPEN succeeded and while the server has not sent CH_CLOSE itself, a CH_CLOSE input whose output lacks CH_CLOSE while the connection stays up is a violation. If the server already closed the channel the mapper reports NO_CHANNEL, which is the 'already sent' exemption; tearing down the whole connection instead is not flagged.
